blocks.text: Air pollutants ke sab se aham aur aam asraat do hain: smog ka banna (14.6.1) aur acid rain (14.6.2).

blocks.prompt: Kaun se pollutants smog aur acid rain dono ke peechhe hain?
blocks.explanation: Jalne se nikalne wale nitrogen oxides (NOₓ) dono mein hain: dhoop mein VOCs ke saath photochemical smog banate hain, aur nami mein ghul kar nitric aur nitrous acids dete hain. Sulphur dioxide classical smog banati hai aur oxidise ho kar sulphuric acid ki shakal mein acid rain ka bara hissa hai.

items: Air pollutants ke do bare asraat: smog aur acid rain.
